$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Hang Reports row (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants from it (its docstring is the row format); schemas/settings/settings-schema.json is still exported from Swift and must not change when rows move here.

lists.name: hangReports
lists.note: Settings > Privacy and Security > Hang Reports, with the View Hang Report button at the end of the category (SettingsSchema.actions(in: .home)).

rows.note: Whether this Mac sends opt-in hang reports (plans/cmux-next/hang-reports-DESIGN.md). Off: nothing is sent until the person turns it on; only NIGHTLY builds send. Agents may not change it (AgentRefusal.privacy).

help.text: Nightly builds send a daily report of hangs and slow frames: call stacks of cmux and macOS code, timings, your app and macOS versions, your Mac's chip and memory size, and rounded counts of open windows and tabs. It never includes file names, web addresses, terminal text, names or anything you type. View Hang Report shows exactly what is sent.

summary.text: Nightly only. No file names, text or addresses.

lists.name: usagePatterns
lists.note: Settings > Privacy and Security > Usage Patterns: opt-in local counters of how the person uses cmux (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-usage-patterns). Leo 2026-11-07: "could we opt in to tracking usage patterns? at least for myself". Off by default; nothing leaves the machine.

rows.note: Whether the daemons on this machine count how cmux is used: commands and operations by name, split directions, connections, agent chats per harness, prompts, tokens, distinct paired machines, by day and hour. Counts and identifiers only, never prompts, terminal text, addresses, file paths or names. Stored locally; `cmux usage-patterns` and the Agent Stats page show them. Agents may not change it (privacy).

help.text: Counts how you use cmux on this computer: commands, pane splits, agent chats, prompts and tokens, and connections, by day and hour. It never records prompts, terminal text, web addresses, file names or anything you type, and nothing is sent anywhere. See them with cmux usage-patterns or on the Agent Stats page.

summary.text: Stays on this computer. Counts only, no text.
